unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering beverages at a cafe or traditional kafeneio
example_en: A medium-sweet Greek coffee, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Masculine in -ές. Plural adds -έδες (οι καφέδες). Direct object accusative: έναν καφέ.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Asking for water in dining establishments
example_en: A bottle of water, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone neuter in -ό. Served automatically in carafes or bottles in Greek cafes.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering hot or cold tea
example_el: Πίνω ζεστό τσάι του βουνού με μέλι.
example_en: I drink hot mountain tea with honey.
notes_or_mnemonics: Neuter in -ι with diphthong (plural: τα τσάγια). 'Τσάι του βουνού' (mountain tea) is an iconic Greek herbal tea.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering non-alcoholic fruit beverages
example_en: I want a fresh orange juice.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone masculine in -ός (accusative: τον χυμό). Note: 'φρέσκος χυμός' = fresh-squeezed juice.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering carbonated fruit soft drinks
example_en: An orangeade with carbonation, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: In Greece, waiters will ask: 'Με ανθρακικό ή χωρίς;' (Sparkling or still?).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering soft drinks
example_en: For me a cold lemonade.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone feminine in -α with plural in -ες.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Specifying coffee additives or ordering breakfast beverages
example_el: Θέλετε τον καφέ με γάλα ή χωρίς γάλα;
example_en: Do you want the coffee with milk or without milk?
notes_or_mnemonics: Irregular neuter noun: adds -τ- in plural (τα γάλατα). 'Με γάλα' = with milk, 'χωρίς γάλα' = without milk.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering alcoholic beverages in tavernas and bars
example_el: Φέρτε μας δύο κρύες μπίρες, παρακαλώ.
example_en: Bring us two cold beers, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Both spellings 'μπίρα' (simplified official) and 'μπύρα' (traditional) are prevalent across Greece.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering wine with meals
example_en: We take half a kilo of red wine.
notes_or_mnemonics: In Greek tavernas, house wine is ordered by the kilo/half-kilo (μισό κιλό χύμα κρασί).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Specifying sweetness level for hot and iced beverages
example_el: Πίνω τον καφέ μου χωρίς ζάχαρη.
example_en: I drink my coffee without sugar.
notes_or_mnemonics: Proparoxytone feminine in -η (plural: οι ζάχαρες). Preposition 'χωρίς' takes accusative: χωρίς ζάχαρη.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Talking about cuisine and meals in general
example_el: Το ελληνικό φαγητό είναι πολύ νόστιμο.
example_en: Greek food is very tasty.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone neuter in -ό. Derived from ancient verb φαγεῖν (to eat).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Requesting bread basket at the table
example_en: Could you bring us some bread, please?
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone neuter in -ί (plural: τα ψωμιά). Staple accompanied item in every Greek meal.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering starters and vegetable salads
example_en: We want a green salad.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone feminine in -α with plural in -ες (οι σαλάτες).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering Greece's signature traditional salad
example_el: Παίρνουμε μία χωριάτικη σαλάτα για τη μέση.
example_en: We take a Greek salad to share (for the middle of the table).
notes_or_mnemonics: Literally: 'village salad'. In Greece, salads are traditionally placed 'για τη μέση' (to share).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering dairy appetisers and ingredients
example_el: Μου αρέσει πολύ το ελληνικό τυρί.
example_en: I like Greek cheese very much.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone neuter in -ί (plural: τα τυριά).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering traditional feta cheese dishes
example_el: Θέλουμε ψητή φέτα με μέλι και σουσάμι.
example_en: We want baked feta with honey and sesame.
notes_or_mnemonics: Also means 'slice' (e.g. μία φέτα ψωμί = a slice of bread).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Inquiring about main courses or dietary preferences
example_en: I do not eat meat, I am a vegetarian.
notes_or_mnemonics: Neuter in -ας with plural in -ατα (τα κρέατα).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering poultry main courses
example_el: Για κυρίως πιάτο θέλω κοτόπουλο με πατάτες.
example_en: For main dish I want chicken with potatoes.
notes_or_mnemonics: Proparoxytone neuter in -ο (plural: τα κοτόπουλα).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering seafood and fresh fish at seaside tavernas
example_en: Do you have fresh fish today?
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone neuter in -ι (plural: τα ψάρια).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering iconic Greek street food
example_el: Παίρνουμε δύο σουβλάκια με πίτα και τζατζίκι.
example_en: We take two souvlakia with pita and tzatziki.
notes_or_mnemonics: Diminutive of σούβλα (spit). Plural: τα σουβλάκια.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering pita wraps or bakery pies (τυρόπιτα, σπανακόπιτα)
example_en: I want a souvlaki in pita bread.
notes_or_mnemonics: Refers both to flatbread for souvlaki and filo pastry pies (τυρόπιτα).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering side dishes (τηγανητές πατάτες)
example_en: One portion of french fries, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: In taverna menus, 'πατάτες τηγανητές' (fried potatoes / fries) is universally ordered in the plural.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering quick cafe snacks
example_el: Ένα τοστ με γαλοπούλα και τυρί.
example_en: A toasted sandwich with turkey and cheese.
notes_or_mnemonics: Foreign loanword: indeclinable neuter noun (το τοστ / τα τοστ).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering post-meal desserts
example_en: What dessert do you have today?
notes_or_mnemonics: Substantivized neuter adjective: το γλυκό (the sweet/dessert), plural: τα γλυκά.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering cold desserts in summer
example_en: I want a chocolate ice cream.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone neuter in -ό (plural: τα παγωτά). Root: παγώνω (to freeze).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Referring to historic Greek social meeting venues
example_el: Οι ηλικιωμένοι πίνουν καφέ στο παραδοσιακό καφενείο.
example_en: The elderly drink coffee at the traditional coffeehouse.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone neuter in -είο. Iconic pillar of Greek community life.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Arranging social meetings at contemporary cafes
example_en: We meet at the cafe in the square.
notes_or_mnemonics: Feminine noun in -ια (plural: οι καφετέριες). Refers to modern cafes (serving freddo espresso/cappuccino).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Choosing dining venues for lunch or dinner
example_el: Το βράδυ τρώμε σε μία ψαροταβέρνα.
example_en: In the evening we eat at a seafood taverna.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone feminine in -α. Core cultural keyword in KEG exam listening dialogues.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Referring to restaurants and dining establishments
example_el: Αυτό το εστιατόριο έχει εξαιρετική θέα.
example_en: This restaurant has an excellent view.
notes_or_mnemonics: Proparoxytone neuter in -ιο (plural: τα εστιατόρια).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Requesting seating in restaurants and cafes
example_el: Ένα τραπέζι για τέσσερα άτομα, παρακαλώ.
example_en: A table for four people, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone neuter in -ι. Phrase 'κάνω το τραπέζι' = to treat someone to a meal.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Asking for the food or drink menu
example_en: Could you bring us the menu, please?
notes_or_mnemonics: Proparoxytone masculine in -ος (plural: οι κατάλογοι). In tavernas also called 'το μενού'.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Asking for the check at the end of a meal
example_en: The bill, please!
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone masculine in -ός (accusative: τον λογαριασμό). Universal payment formula in Greece.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Tipping dining service personnel
example_en: We leave a tip on the table.
notes_or_mnemonics: Compound from φίλος (friend) + δώρο (gift). Proparoxytone neuter in -μα.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Expressing wishes and placing dining orders
example_en: I want a glass of cold water.
notes_or_mnemonics: Core Type A modal verb. Present: θέλω, θέλεις, θέλει, θέλουμε, θέλετε, θέλουν. Triggers 'να + verb': θέλω να παραγγείλω.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Talking about beverage consumption habits
example_el: Τι πίνετε; — Πίνω έναν ζεστό καφέ.
example_en: What are you drinking? — I am drinking a hot coffee.
notes_or_mnemonics: Type A active verb. Present paradigm: πίνω, πίνεις, πίνει, πίνουμε, πίνετε, πίνουν.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
back_primary: to take / to order / to have (food/drink)
keg_communicative_function: Standard conversational verb used when placing orders
example_el: Εγώ παίρνω μία χωριάτικη σαλάτα και ένα σουβλάκι.
example_en: I will take a Greek salad and a souvlaki.
notes_or_mnemonics: Type A active verb. In ordering context, 'παίρνω' is the most natural verb: 'Τι θα πάρετε;' (What will you have?).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Talking about food consumption and dietary habits
example_en: We eat lunch at two o'clock.
notes_or_mnemonics: Contracted present forms: τρώω, τρως, τρώει, τρώμε, τρώτε, τρώνε. Note spelling with omega and tonos.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Explicitly initiating an order at a restaurant or shop
example_en: We are ready to order.
notes_or_mnemonics: Type A active verb: παραγγέλνω, παραγγέλνεις, παραγγέλνει, παραγγέλνουμε, παραγγέλνετε, παραγγέλνουν.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
back_primary: here you are / certainly / what can I get you?
keg_communicative_function: Handing something over or responding politely to customers
example_el: — Έναν καφέ, παρακαλώ. — Ορίστε, ο καφές σας!
example_en: — A coffee, please. — Here you are, your coffee!
notes_or_mnemonics: Versatile Greek particle: used when handing over items ('Here you go'), answering the door/phone ('Yes?'), or acknowledging a customer.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)

grammatical_info.structure: για + strong personal pronoun in accusative (μένα)

keg_communicative_function: Specifying one's individual choice in a group order
example_en: For me a beer, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Preposition 'για' takes strong accusative: για μένα (for me), για σένα (for you).

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
back_primary: what will you have? / what can I get you?
keg_communicative_function: Understanding standard waiter inquiry in listening tests
example_el: Γεια σας, τι θα πάρετε παρακαλώ;
example_en: Hello, what will you have, please?
notes_or_mnemonics: The universal question posed by Greek waiters and kiosk clerks to start a transaction.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Wishing dining companions a pleasant meal
example_el: Το φαγητό έφτασε. Καλή όρεξη σε όλους!
example_en: The food has arrived. Enjoy your meal, everyone!
notes_or_mnemonics: Literally: 'Good appetite'. Addressed to anyone sitting down to eat.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Making toasts when drinking wine or beer
example_en: Cheers, guys! (To our health!)
notes_or_mnemonics: Contraction of 'σε + την υγεία μας'. Also commonly shortened to 'γεια μας!'.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Specifying sweetness level when ordering Greek coffee or frappé
example_el: Έναν φραπέ μέτριο με γάλα, παρακαλώ.
example_en: A medium-sweet frappé with milk, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: In Greek coffee culture: 'μέτριος' means 1 spoon of coffee and 1 spoon of sugar.

unit_theme: Στο Καφέ & Στην Ταβέρνα (Ordering Food & Drinks)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering unsweetened coffee or plain food items
example_en: I always drink my coffee plain (without sugar).
notes_or_mnemonics: The three standard coffee sugar levels are: σκέτος (0 sugar), μέτριος (1 sugar), γλυκός (2 sugar).
